title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history
english: The Democratic Republic of Congo is facing its deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, with the death toll surpassing 2,300 victims. The virus is spreading at an alarming rate across six provinces, complicated by regional conflict and high population movement. While researchers are working on new vaccines for this specific strain, health authorities are struggling to curb the rapid transmission of the disease.
amharic: የኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ እስካሁን ካየቻቸው ሁሉ የከፋውን የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ እያስተናገደች ሲሆን የሟቾች ቁጥርም ከ2,300 በላይ ሆኗል። ቫይረሱ በስድስት አውራጃዎች በፍጥነት እየተስፋፋ ሲሆን የአካባቢው ግጭትና የህዝብ እንቅስቃሴ ቁጥጥሩን አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል። ተመራማሪዎች ለዚህ የኢቦላ ዝርያ ክትባቶችን ለማዘጋጀት እየሞከሩ ቢሆንም፣ የጤና ባለሙያዎች የበሽታውን ስርጭት ለመግታት ከፍተኛ ትግል እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Jamhuuriyya Dimokraatawaa Koongoo keessatti dhibeen Ebola hanga ammaatti mudatee beekamu keessaa isa hamaa ta’ee fi namoota 2,300 ol galaafate mudachuu isaa gabaafameera. Vaayirasichi naannolee jahan keessatti saffisaan kan babal’achaa jiru yoo ta’u, waraanaa fi sochiin ummataa to’achuuf rakkoo ta’ee jira. Qorattoonni vaayirasicha ittisuuf qoricha (vaaksinii) haaraa qopheessaa kan jiran ta’us, ogeeyyonni fayyaa babal’ina dhibee kanaa dhaabuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru.

title: Lawyer says Israel’s targeting of Palestinian women is a form of genocide
english: Palestinian lawyer Ahmad Ibsais contends that the ongoing Israeli military actions in Gaza, which have resulted in the deaths of thousands of women and children, constitute a form of genocide. He argues that the specific targeting of Palestinian women is a critical issue that international legal frameworks have failed to adequately address. Since the conflict began in October 2023, the death toll in the region has surpassed 73,000 individuals.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ጠበቃ አህመድ ኢብሳይስ በእስራኤል እየተካሄደ ያለው ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሴቶችና ህጻናትን በመግደሉ ይህ ድርጊት የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል አካል ነው ብለዋል። ጠበቃው አክለውም ዓለም አቀፍ ህግ የፍልስጤም ሴቶችን ኢላማ ያደረገውን ጥቃት ችላ ማለቱን ተችተዋል። ከጥቅምት 2016 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ በተቀሰቀሰው ጦርነት እስካሁን ከ73,000 በላይ ሰዎች መሞታቸው ታውቋል።
oromo: Ogeessi seeraa Falasxiin Ahmad Ibsais akka jedhutti, tarkaanfiin waraana Israa'el Gaazaatti fudhachaa jirtu, kan dubartootaafi ijoollee kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman galaafate, akka sanyi-dhumaatti ilaalama. Inni akka jedhutti, qaamoleen idil-addunyaa miidhaa dubartoota Falasxiin irra gahaa jiru kana xiyyeeffannoo gahaa kennuufii dhabaniiru. Waraanni Adoolessa 2023 eegale kun hanga ammaatti lubbuu namoota 73,000 ol ta'ee galaafateera.

title: Actress Hayden Panettiere dies aged 36, US media report
english: American actress Hayden Panettiere has passed away at the age of 36, according to statements from her family. Known for her performances in popular television shows like Heroes and Nashville, she began her acting career as a young child. Her family has requested privacy while they mourn this unexpected loss, and the specific cause of her death remains undisclosed.
amharic: አሜሪካዊቷ ተዋናይት ሃይደን ፓኔቲየር በ36 ዓመቷ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት መለየቷን ቤተሰቦቿ አስታውቀዋል። እንደ ሄሮውስ እና ናሽቪል ባሉ ተወዳጅ የቴሌቪዥን ድራማዎች የምትታወቀው ሃይደን፣ የትወና ስራዋን የጀመረችው ገና በልጅነቷ ነበር። ቤተሰቦቿ በዚህ አሳዛኝ ሁኔታ ውስጥ የግል መጠጊያ እንዲሰጣቸው የጠየቁ ሲሆን፣ የአሟሟቷ ምክንያት እስካሁን በይፋ አልታወቀም።
oromo: Aartistiin Ameerikaa Hayden Panettiere umurii ishee waggaa 36tti du’aan boqochuun maatiin ishee ibsaniiru. Taphoota televijiinii beekamoo akka ‘Heroes’ fi ‘Nashville’ irratti kan hirmaatte Hayden, hojii ishee kan jalqabde yeroo ijoollummaa isheetti ture. Maatiin ishee gadda kana keessatti kabajaafi nagaa akka isaaniif kennamu gaafatanis, sababa du’a ishee ilaalchisee hamma ammaatti ifa kan hin taaneedha.

title: Thieves steal Renaissance artworks in museum heist during Italian holiday
english: Thieves stole four valuable Renaissance paintings by Antonello da Messina from the MuMe museum in Sicily while the city was busy celebrating a major holiday. The burglars broke through the museum's perimeter and display cases, taking pieces worth millions of euros, though they left two panels behind. Authorities are investigating the heist, which took place while security forces were distracted by large public festivities.
amharic: በሲሲሊ በበዓል አከባበር ወቅት ሌቦች በአንቶኔሎ ዳ መሲና የተሳሉ አራት ውድ የህዳሴ ዘመን ሥዕሎችን ከሙሜ ሙዚየም ሰርቀዋል። ወንጀለኞቹ የሙዚየሙን አጥር እና የመስታወት ሳጥኖች ሰብረው በመግባት በሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠር ዩሮ የሚያወጡ ቅርሶችን የወሰዱ ሲሆን፣ ሁለቱን ስዕሎች ግን ትተዋቸዋል። ባለሥልጣናቱ የፖሊስ ትኩረት በሕዝባዊ በዓል ላይ በነበረበት ወቅት የተፈጸመውን ይህን ዘረፋ እያጣሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hattootni fakkiiwwan warraaqsa Aartii (Renaissance) kan Antonello da Messina, kan gatiin isaanii miliyoonaan kaffalu, buufata Siisilii keessatti argamu irraa hataniiru. Hattootni kun guyyaa ayyaana guddaa magaalaan kun kabajamaa jirtu fayyadamanii, mana kuusaa sana keessatti namoonni yeroo ayyaana irratti xiyyeeffatanitti seentanii hatan. Hattootni kun fakkiiwwan muraasa fudhatanii kanneen biroo bakka sana dhiisanii kan deeman yoo ta'u, qorannoon yakka kanaa itti fufee jira.

title: Ongoing Israeli attacks across southern Lebanon, two injured in Bint Jbeil
english: Israeli military forces have launched a series of airstrikes and artillery attacks across various locations in southern Lebanon. A drone strike on a home in the Bint Jbeil district resulted in injuries to two civilians and caused significant property damage. These ongoing military operations have affected several towns, including al-Qantara, Khiam, and al-Mansouri.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች የአየር እና የመድፍ ጥቃቶችን አድርሰዋል። በቢንት ጅቤል አውራጃ ውስጥ በአንድ መኖሪያ ቤት ላይ በደረሰ የድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ሲቪሎች ላይ ጉዳት የደረሰ ሲሆን ቤቱም ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አስተናግዷል። እነዚህ የጦር እንቅስቃሴዎች አል-ቃንታራን፣ ኪያምን እና አል-ማንሱሪን ጨምሮ በበርካታ ከተሞች ላይ ተጽዕኖ ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el kutaa kibba Libaanoos keessatti bakkeewwan garaagaraatti haleellaa qilleensaa fi meeshaa waraanaan raawwatanii jiru. Godina Bint Jbeil keessatti manaa irratti haleellaa xiyyaara nama malee (drone) gaggeeffameen namoonni nagaa lama madaa'aniiru, akkasumas qabeenyi miidhameera. Hojiiwwan waraanaa kun al-Qantara, Khiam fi al-Mansouri dabalatee magaalota hedduu irratti dhiibbaa geessiseera.

title: US senator slams Trump, Hegseth over 'disgraceful' disregard for American troops
english: Senator Chris Van Hollen has publicly criticized Donald Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth for neglecting the well-being of American soldiers. His remarks follow reports revealing harsh living conditions on U.S. naval ships, such as food shortages and poor sanitation. The senator argued that these leaders are failing to support military personnel and emphasized that ending ongoing conflicts is essential to protect them.
amharic: ሴናተር ክሪስ ቫን ሆለን የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች እየደረሰባቸው ባለው ችግር ዶናልድ ትራምፕን እና የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሰትን በኃላፊነት እንደማይሰማቸው በመግለጽ ተችተዋል። ይህ ትችት የተሰነዘረው በዩኤስ የባህር ኃይል መርከቦች ውስጥ የንጽህና ጉድለት፣ የምግብ እና የውሃ እጥረት እንዲሁም ወታደሮች የከፋ ድካም ውስጥ መሆናቸው ከተሰማ በኋላ ነው። ሴናተሩ ወታደሮቹን ለመጠበቅ አሁን ያለውን ጦርነት ማቆም ወሳኝ እንደሆነ አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Senator Kris Vaan Hollen, Trump fi ministira ittisa biyyaa Piit Hegseth waraana Ameerikaatiif xiyyeeffannoo dhabuusaanii isaanii cimsanii balaaleffataniiru. Yaanni kun kan dhufe, dooniiwwan waraana Ameerikaa keessatti hanqina nyaataa, bishaanii fi qulqullinaa akkasumas dadhabbii cimaa waraantotaa ibsuun gabaasamee booda. Senatarichi waraana itti fufaa jiru dhaabuun qofa waraantota keenya fi maatiisaanii eeguuf filannoo gaarii akka ta'e dubbateera.

title: IRGC official warns adversaries to 'anticipate strategic surprises'
english: A high-ranking commander of Iran's Revolutionary Guard has issued a warning to the country's opponents, stating that their military strategy is moving from a defensive to an offensive posture. He emphasized that Iran is fully prepared to counter threats and urged adversaries to be ready for unexpected tactical actions. The official reiterated that any measures needed to protect national security will be implemented whenever the situation demands.
amharic: የኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘብ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ አዛዥ አገሪቱ ከመከላከያ ወደ ጥቃት መውጫ ወታደራዊ ስትራቴጂ እየተሸጋገረች መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ጠላቶች ከኢራን ያልተጠበቁ እና ስልታዊ እርምጃዎችን ሊጠብቁ እንደሚገባ አዛዡ አስጠንቅቀዋል። አገሪቱ የደህንነቷን ጉዳይ ለማስከበር እና ማንኛውንም አይነት ስጋት ለመመከት አስፈላጊውን ሁሉ ለማድረግ ዝግጁ መሆኗን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan olaanoo waraana tiksee jijjiiramaa Iraan (IRGC), biyyi isaanii tarsiimoo ittisaa irraa gara tarsiimoo haleellaatti ceʼaa akka jiru akeekkachiisaniiru. Diinonni biyyattii tarkaanfiiwwan abdatamuu hin dandeenye irraa eeggachuu akka qaban ibsaniiru. Biyyattiin nageenya ishee kabajchiisuufi diinota ishee dura dhaabbachuuf murannoo akka qabdu hoggantichi dubbateera.

title: Report: Israeli military prepares for possible escalation in Lebanon
english: The Israeli military is preparing for a potential multi-day escalation of conflict along the Lebanese border. Although government officials have recently avoided some proposed military strikes to keep diplomatic peace talks open, ongoing violence continues to result in significant casualties. The situation remains volatile as military planning proceeds alongside these stalled negotiations.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በሊባኖስ ድንበር ላይ ለሚከሰት የበርካታ ቀናት ግጭት ዝግጅት እያደረገ ነው። የሀገሪቱ መንግስት የሰላም ንግግሮችን ላለማስተጓጎል ሲል አንዳንድ የጦርነት ዕቅዶችን የዘገየ ቢሆንም፣ በየቀኑ በሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት እየጠፋ ይገኛል። የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቶች ቢኖሩም በሁለቱ አካላት መካከል ያለው ውጥረት አሁንም በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Israa'el daangaa Libaanoos irratti walitti bu'iinsa guyyoota hedduuf turuu danda'uuf qophii gochaa jira. Mootummaan Israa'el marii nagaa akka hin miineef tarkaanfii waraanaa tokko tokko kan ittise ta'us, haleellaa ammayyuu itti fufeen lubbuun namoota hedduu darbaa jira. Mariin nagaa utuu jiruu, haalli waraanaa kun ammayyuu sodaachisaa fi kan hin tasgabboofne ta'uun ibsameera.

title: Tehran's foreign ministry slams Canada for backing US war on Iran
english: The Iranian foreign ministry has publicly condemned Canada for its involvement in U.S.-led military actions against Iran. A spokesperson criticized Ottawa for prioritizing American interests despite receiving poor treatment from Washington regarding trade and policy. This statement highlights Iran's view that Canada is merely acting as a subservient partner in conflict rather than an independent actor.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ካናዳ በአሜሪካ የሚመራው በኢራን ላይ የሚደረገውን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ በመደገፏ በይፋ ተችቷል። የኢራን ቃል አቀባይ እንዳሉት ካናዳ በንግድ እና በፖሊሲ ረገድ ከአሜሪካ ተገቢ ያልሆነ አያያዝ ቢደርስባትም የአሜሪካን ፍላጎት በማስቀደሟ ተጠያቂ ናት። ይህ መግለጫ ካናዳ በግጭቶች ውስጥ ገለልተኛ አካል ከመሆን ይልቅ የአሜሪካን አጀንዳ እንደምትፈጽም የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Ministeerri dhimma alaa Iraan, Kanadaa tarkaanfii waraana ykn lola Ameerikaan Iraan irratti geggeessitu keessatti hirmaachuu isheetiif balaaleffateera. Dubbi himaan ministeerichaa, Kanadaan daldalaa fi siyaasa ilaalchisee Ameerikaarraa qormaata hedduu darbuus, fedhii Ameerikaa dursee raawwachuun ishee kan nama gaddisiisuudha jedhan. Haasaa kanaan, Kanadaan lola kana keessatti of danda'ee kan socho'u osoo hin taane, raawwachiiftuu fedhii Ameerikaa taatee akka jirtu ibsameera.

title: Palestinian-American travels to West Bank home encircled by Israeli settler
english: A Palestinian-American named Loui Ridi is traveling from the United States to the West Bank to reach his elderly mother. She is currently trapped alongside 14 other Palestinians in their homes in the village of Qusra. For over a week, these individuals have been surrounded by illegal Israeli settlers, leaving them in a dangerous and isolated situation.
amharic: ሉዊ ሪዲ የተባሉ አሜሪካዊው ፍልስጤማዊ፣ በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚገኘውን የትውልድ መንደራቸውን ለማየት ከአሜሪካ ጉዞ ጀምረዋል። የእሳቸው እናት በኩስራ መንደር ከሌሎች 14 ፍልስጤማውያን ጋር በቤታቸው ተከበው ለአንድ ሳምንት ያህል ተጥለው ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ሰዎች ህገ-ወጥ በሆኑ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች የተከበቡ በመሆናቸው በአደገኛ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Namni Ameerikaa fi Filisxeemii Loui Ridi jedhamu, gara Qixxee gara jiru maatii isaa fi haadha isaa dulloomte bira ga'uuf Ameerikaarraa imala jalqabeera. Haati isaa fi namoonni 14 biroon gandicha keessatti manneen isaanii keessatti qabamanii torban tokkoo ol ta'eera. Namoonni kunneen qubsuma seeraan alaa kan ta'an qubsiistota Israa'elitiin marfamanii haala sodaachisaa keessa jiru.

title: Rare Pallas’s cat captured on camera in northern Iran mountains
english: A rare Pallas’s cat was recently filmed in the remote Nava highlands of northern Iran’s Mazandaran province. This elusive wild feline is seldom seen, making the captured footage a significant discovery for wildlife enthusiasts. Conservationists view this sighting as an important moment for documenting the region's biodiversity.
amharic: በሰሜን ኢራን ማዛንዳራን ግዛት በሚገኙ ተራራማ አካባቢዎች እጅግ ብርቅዬ የሆነው የፓላስ ድመት በካሜራ ተቀረጸ። ይህ አይነቱ የዱር ድመት በቀላሉ የማይታይ በመሆኑ ምስሉ ትልቅ ግኝት ሆኗል። የተፈጥሮ ተመራማሪዎች ይህ ክስተት የአካባቢውን የዱር እንስሳት ሀብት ለመረዳት ወሳኝ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pilaasii (Pallas’s cat) kan jedhamu fi gosa adurree bosonaa baay'ee hin argamne tokko, kaaba Iran naannoo Mazandaranitti viidiyoodhaan qabameera. Adurreen kun argachuun isaa baay'ee kan ulfaatu ta'uu isaa irraa kan ka'e, qabamuu suuraa isaa kana guddina guddaa godheera. Hayyoonni uumamaa, argannoon kun bineensota bosonaa naannichaa keessa jiran qorachuuf gumaacha guddaa akka qabu ibsaniiru.

title: Zambia incumbent takes early election lead as opposition alleges armed raid
english: Zambian President Hakainde Hichilema is currently leading the national election with nearly 59 percent of the votes counted, positioning him for a potential first-round win. However, the process has been marred by violence, including the death of a polling agent and serious allegations from the opposition regarding an armed raid on a candidate's home. International observers have also raised concerns about the fairness of the campaign and irregularities during the ballot counting process.
amharic: የዛምቢያው ፕሬዚዳንት ሃካይንዴ ሂቺሌማ በሀገሪቱ እየተካሄደ ባለው አጠቃላይ ምርጫ፣ እስካሁን በተቆጠረው ድምፅ ወደ 59 በመቶ በማግኘት ቀዳሚ ሆነዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የምርጫ ሂደቱ በአመጽ ድርጊቶች እና በተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎች በኩል በቀረቡ ከባድ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት ክሶች ታጅቦ ቀጥሏል። አለም አቀፍ ታዛቢዎች የምርጫው አሰጣጥ ፍትሃዊነት እና በድምፅ አቆጣጠር ወቅት የታዩ መቆራረጦች ላይ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantii Zaambiyaa Haakaindee Hiichiileemaa sagalee hanga amma lakkaa'ame keessaa dhibbeentaa 59 ol argachuun filannoo biyyattii dursee jira. Ta'us, adeemsi filannichaa jeequmsa fi himannaa diinonni siyaasaa mana isaanii irratti weerarri hidhattootaa raawwatame jedhaniin kan guutame ture. Akkasumas, mormitoonni fi daawwattoonni idil-addunyaa adeemsa filannichaa fi lakkoofsa sagalee irratti rakkoo fi wal-qixxummaa dhabuu jiraachuu isaatiin yaaddoo isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in country’s history
english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing its deadliest Ebola outbreak ever, with 2,325 deaths surpassing the previous record set during the 2018-2020 crisis. UN officials are calling for urgent international support, noting that the virus is spreading rapidly due to ongoing conflict and limited medical resources. Because there are no approved vaccines for this specific strain, the death rate has climbed significantly, highlighting a critical need for a faster humanitarian response.
amharic: በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ እየተከሰተ ያለው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ከ2,325 በላይ ሰዎችን በመግደል በሀገሪቱ ታሪክ እጅግ አስከፊው ሆኗል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የጤና ባለሙያዎች ወረርሽኙ በግጭት እና በጤና መሠረተ ልማት እጥረት ምክንያት በፍጥነት እየተስፋፋ መሆኑን በመግለጽ አስቸኳይ ዓለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ ጠይቀዋል። ለዚህ የኢቦላ ዝርያ ተቀባይነት ያለው ክትባት ባለመኖሩ የሟቾች ቁጥር እየጨመረ በመሄዱ ፈጣን የሰብአዊ ድጋፍ መደረግ እንዳለበት ተገልጿል።
oromo: Itoophiyaa keessatti kan hin taane garuu, biyya Koongoo keessatti dhibeen Ebolaa namoota 2,325 ol galaafachuun kisaaraa hamaa seenaa biyyattii keessatti mudate ta'eera. Bakka buutonni Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii dhibeen kun walitti bu'iinsa fi hanqina tajaajila fayyaa irraa kan ka'e ariitiin babal'achaa waan jiruuf deeggarsi idil-addunyaa hatattamaa akka barbaachisu ibsaniiru. Dhibee kanaaf qorichi ykn talaalliin hayyamame waan hin jirreef, lakkoofsi namoota du'anii dabalaa jiraachuun rakkoo guddaa keessa akka galan ifa godheera.

title: Israeli settlers pitch tents for new illegal outpost in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli settlers have set up tents to establish new illegal outposts near Ramallah in the occupied West Bank, further encroaching on Palestinian land. Simultaneously, a group of Palestinian families in the village of Qusra remains under a week-long siege by settlers and soldiers. Additionally, Israeli forces recently raided a home in Beit Imrin, where they arrested several Palestinians and obstructed medical relief efforts.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ራማላ አቅራቢያ አዳዲስ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈሮችን ለመመስረት ድንኳኖችን ተክለዋል። በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ በቁስራ መንደር የሚኖሩ የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች ለአንድ ሳምንት ሙሉ በሰፋሪዎች እና በወታደሮች ከበባ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። በተጨማሪም የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በቤይት ኢምሪን ከተማ በሚገኝ አንድ ቤት ላይ ወረራ በማካሄድ በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር ማዋላቸው እና የህክምና እርዳታ እንዳይደርስ ማገዳቸው ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Baballistoonni Israa'el naannoo Qilleensaa irra jiraattotaa (West Bank) kan ta'e Ramallaah biratti kampiiwwan seeraan alaa dhaabuuf dunkaana dhaaban. Yeroo wal fakkaatuuttis, maatiin warra Filisxeemii baadiyaa Qusraa jiraatan torban tokko guutuu baballistootaa fi waraanaan marfamanii jiru. Kana malees, waraanni Israa'el manaa jireenyaa magaalaa Beit Imrin keessatti argamu weeraruun namoota Filisxeemii hedduu hidhaniiru akkasumas gargaarsi fayyaa akka hin geenye dhorkaniiru.

title: Can the AU make its current Sudan mission count?
english: A delegation from the African Union has arrived in Sudan for a two-day visit aimed at brokering a ceasefire and improving humanitarian aid access. While the Sudanese military has recently reclaimed some territory, the conflict remains deadlocked, making a diplomatic solution difficult to achieve. The AU is working to move beyond just stopping the fighting by encouraging a broader, civilian-led political process to restore long-term stability.
amharic: የአፍሪካ ህብረት ልዑካን ቡድን በሱዳን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ እና የሰብአዊ እርዳታ አቅርቦትን ለማሻሻል የሁለት ቀን ጉብኝት ጀምሯል። የሱዳን ጦር በቅርቡ የተወሰኑ አካባቢዎችን ቢቆጣጠርም፣ በሁለቱ ተፋላሚ ኃይሎች መካከል ያለው የኃይል ሚዛን አሁንም ተቀራራቢ በመሆኑ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄ ለማምጣት አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል። ህብረቱ ግጭቱን ከማስቆም ባለፈ፣ ለረጅም ጊዜ የሚቆይ ሰላምን ለማረጋገጥ በሲቪል መሪዎች የሚመራ ሁሉን አቀፍ የፖለቲካ ሂደትን ለመጀመር እየሰራ ነው።
oromo: Ergamtooni Gamtaa Afrikaa waraana Sudaan dhaabsisuufi gargaarsi namoomaa akka ga’u mari’achuuf guyyoota lamaaf biyyattii daawwachuuf dhufaniiru. Waraanni Sudaan naannoolee tokko tokko deebisee to’atus, lolli kun hanga ammaatti furmaata waaraa dhabee jira. Gamtaan Afrikaa waraana dhaabsisuu qofa osoo hin taane, nageenya biyyattii deebisanii dhaabuuf hirmaannaa qaamolee siivilii fayyadamuun furmaata siyaasaa argamsiisuuf yaalii gochaa jira.

title: Trump says US to ‘substantially reduce’ military drills with South Korea
english: President Donald Trump has directed the Pentagon to significantly scale back upcoming joint military drills with South Korea, labeling the exercises as expensive and provocative toward North Korea. Trump cited his positive personal rapport with Kim Jong Un as the primary reason for his dissatisfaction with the long-standing military alliance activities. Despite this directive, South Korean defense officials stated that the planned training exercises will continue as originally scheduled.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከደቡብ ኮሪያ ጋር የሚደረጉትን የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዲቀንሱ ለፔንታጎን አዘዋል። ትራምፕ ልምምዶቹን ውድ እና በሰሜን ኮሪያ ላይ ጠበኝነትን የሚያሳዩ ናቸው በማለት ለሰሜን ኮሪያ መሪ ኪም ጆንግ ኡን ካላቸው መልካም ግንኙነት አንፃር እርምጃውን እንደማይደግፉ ገልጸዋል። ሆኖም የደቡብ ኮሪያ የመከላከያ ሚኒስቴር የታቀደው ወታደራዊ ልምምድ እንደ ቀድሞው መርሐግብር እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቋል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Dooktar Doonaald Tiraamp, leenjii waraanaa gama gamanaan Koriyaa Kibbaa wajjin ta’u hir’isuuf Pentagon ajajanii jiru. Tiraamp leenjii kana baasii guddaa kan gaafatu fi Koriyaa Kaabaatiifis kan roorroo qabuudha jedhanii, walitti dhufeenya isaan Koriyaa Kaabaa wajjin qabanirratti hundaa’uun mormii qaban ibsanii jiru. Haa ta’u malee, Ministeerri Ittisaa Koriyaa Kibbaa leenjiin waraanaa kun akka karoora duraatti itti fufuuf akka jiru beeksiseera.

title: Israel releases 35 Palestinian prisoners back into Gaza
english: Israeli authorities have released 35 Palestinian prisoners who have returned home to the Gaza Strip. This event follows reports from human rights organizations alleging severe mistreatment, including torture and abuse, within the Israeli detention system. Currently, thousands of other Palestinians continue to be held in Israeli custody.

english: UN official Francesca Albanese has accused Israel of using settlers to intimidate Palestinians in the West Bank. Albanese emphasized that the Israeli government is ultimately responsible for these acts of coercion carried out by civilian groups.

english: Israel's far-right National Security Minister, Itamar Ben-Gvir, has sparked controversy by calling for the nightly killing of 30 to 40 people in Gaza. During a recent podcast appearance, he expressed extremist views, suggesting that many Palestinians in the region should not be considered human or worthy of life. Although Ben-Gvir lacks the formal authority to direct military actions, his position on the security cabinet allows him to significantly influence Israeli war policies.

title: Jared Kushner lands in Israel after meeting Hamas officials
english: Jared Kushner, a senior adviser to former President Donald Trump, traveled to Israel following discussions with Hamas leaders and representatives from Egypt, Qatar, and Turkey. english: Former U.S. President Donald Trump stated that he reached out to the South Korean leader to see if they would assist in American initiatives to remove nuclear weapons from Iran. english: Violence by Israeli settlers against Palestinians in the West Bank has significantly increased under the current far-right government. english: Moroccan authorities have detained nearly 300 migrants and 61 suspected smugglers during a recent attempt to reach the Spanish territory of Ceuta. Thousands of migrants who successfully entered the enclave are now living in difficult conditions on local beaches while demanding asylum and protesting their potential return to Morocco.

oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Marookoo baqattoota gara naannoo Ispeen Se'uutaatti ce'uuf yaalii godhan guddina 300 gahan fi namoota 61 imala kana mijeessan jedhaman to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame erga torban lama dura yaalii godaansaa daangaa irratti lubbuun namoota baay'ee darbe booda. Baqattoonni yeroo ammaa Se'uuta keessatti haala ulfaataa keessa jiran, gara Marookootti deebi'uu diduun qulqullina fi mirga kooluu galtummaa akka argatan gaafachaa jiru.

title: Four 'extraordinary' Renaissance paintings stolen from Italian museum
english: Four highly valuable Renaissance-era paintings created by Antonello da Messina were stolen from a museum in Sicily, Italy, on Saturday night. Authorities are investigating how the thieves bypassed security systems and alarm sensors to remove the items, including one piece taken directly from a display case. Officials suspect the heist may have been a targeted theft intended for the black market.
amharic: አራት እጅግ ውድ የሆኑ የህዳሴ ዘመን የጥበብ ስራዎች በጣሊያን ሲሲሊ በሚገኝ ሙዚየም ውስጥ ቅዳሜ ምሽት ተሰረቁ። አጥፊዎቹ የሙዚየሙን የደህንነት ስርዓት እና ማንቂያ እንዴት እንዳለፉ ባለስልጣናት በምርመራ ላይ ናቸው። ስርቆቱ ጥቁር ገበያ ላይ ለመሸጥ ታቅዶ የተፈጸመ ወንጀል ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተገምቷል።
oromo: Hojiiwwan aartii yeroo Renaissance kan gatiin isaanii guddaa ta'e afur, magaalaa Siisilii, Xaaliyaanii keessatti argamu irraa galgala Sanbata duraa hatamaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa hattoonni kun sirna eegumsaa fi sagalee akeekkachiisaa akkamitti akka darban qorachaa jiru. Hatti kun gabaa gurraachaaf kan qophaa'e ta'uu akka danda'u shakkamaa jira.

title: Anwar Ibrahim: Malaysia between the superpowers
english: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim discussed the challenges smaller nations face amidst the increasing competition between global superpowers. He emphasized the need for middle powers to maintain their sovereignty and promote a rules-based international order even when larger countries ignore established laws. The discussion focused on how nations like Malaysia can protect their own interests while navigating complex trade and political rivalries.
amharic: የማሌዢያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዋር ኢብራሂም በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በታላላቅ ሀገራት መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣው ፉክክር ትናንሽ ሀገራትን ለከፍተኛ ፈተና እየዳረገ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ታላላቅ ሀገራት ዓለም አቀፍ ህጎችን በሚጥሱበት ወቅት መካከለኛ አቅም ያላቸው ሀገራት ሉዓላዊነታቸውን በማስጠበቅ በራሳቸው መንገድ መጓዝ እንዳለባቸው አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል። ማሌዢያም ይህን ውስብስብ የፖለቲካ እና የንግድ ፉክክር በመጠቀም የራሷን ጥቅም እንዴት እንደምትጠብቅ በውይይታቸው አንስተዋል።
oromo: Muummee ministiraa Maleeziyaa Anwaar Ibraahiim, dorgommii biyyoota gurguddoo addunyaa gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiruun biyyootni xixiqqoon rakkoo keessa akka jiran ibsaniiru. Biyyootni sadarkaa giddu galeessaa irra jiran, biyyootni gurguddoon seera addunyaa yoo cabsaniyyuu, of danda'anii fi seera kabachiisuudhaan of eeguu akka qaban hubachiisaniiru. Mariin isaanii, biyyootni akka Maleeziyaa daldalaa fi siyaasa addunyaa keessatti faayidaa mataa isaanii akkamitti eeggachuu akka danda'an irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture.

title: Death toll rises to 84 from capsized ferry in Zimbabwe
english: A ferry accident on Lake Kariba has resulted in at least 84 deaths after the overloaded vessel capsized during strong winds. The boat was carrying more people than its official capacity while traveling toward remote fishing communities. President Mnangagwa has acknowledged the tragedy, noting that it highlights severe transportation infrastructure issues in the region.
amharic: ዚምባብዌ ውስጥ ካሪባ ሐይቅ ላይ በተፈጠረ የጀልባ አደጋ ቢያንስ 84 ሰዎች መሞታቸው ተረጋግጧል። ጀልባዋ ከቅቡ አቅሟ በላይ በመጫኗ እና በጠንካራ ንፋስ ምክንያት ነው የገለበጠችው። የሀገሪቱ ፕሬዝዳንት ኤመርሰን ምናንጋግዋ አደጋውን አስከፊ ነው ብለው፣ ይህ ክስተት በዘርፉ ያለውን የመሰረተ ልማት ችግር የሚያሳይ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Zimbabwee keessatti markabni haroo Kaaribaa keessatti galgaleeroo sadarkaa lubbuu dabarsuu kanaan namoonni 84 ol du'aniiru. Markabichi namoota baay'ee fe'ee fi bubbee cimaan waan rukutameef gadi garagaleera. Prezidaantiin biyyattii Emmerson Mnangagwa balaa kana balaaleffatanii, balaan kun rakkoo geejjibaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa biyyattii keessatti mul'atu kan agarsiisu ta'uu dubbataniiru.

title: Recap of latest developments in West Bank
english: Tensions rose in the occupied West Bank as Israeli settlers attacked a Palestinian doctor and besieged a home, resulting in the detention of nine residents by Israeli forces. Additionally, military units raided the village of al-Mughayyir, and settlers unsuccessfully attempted to steal horses in Tayasir. These incidents highlight the ongoing instability and violence affecting various Palestinian communities across the region.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በፈጸሙት ጥቃት አንድ የፍልስጤም ዶክተር መቁሰላቸውን እና ዘጠኝ ፍልስጤማውያንን በአንድ ቤት ከበው በኃይላቸው እንዲያዙ ማድረጋቸውን ዘገባዎች አመላክተዋል። በተጨማሪም የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በአል-ሙጋይር መንደር ወረራ ያካሄዱ ሲሆን በታያስር መንደር የሚገኙ የፈረስ ባለቤቶችም የሰፋሪዎች የስርቆት ሙከራ ገጥሟቸዋል። እነዚህ ክስተቶች በአካባቢው እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጸጥታ መደፍረስና ግጭት ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Naannoo Zoonii Dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti weeraraa fi jeequmsi itti fufee jiraachuu gabaasameera. Gareen Israa'el tokko doktera Falasxiinaa tokko irratti reebicha raawwatanii fi maatii sagal mana tokko keessatti marsanii qabsiisuun humnoota Israa'eliin akka hidhaman taasisaniiru. Kana malees, waraanni Israa'el baadiyaa al-Mughayyir weeraruu fi gochi hattootaa farda horii hatuuf yaalan Taayasiir keessatti mul'ateera. Gochootni kun haala nagaa dhabuu fi walitti bu'iinsa naannichatti babal'achaa jiru kan calaqqisiisani dha.

title: Israelis harass Palestinian-owned cafe in Iceland, tear down Palestine map
english: A group of suspected Israeli tourists recently caused a disturbance at a Palestinian-owned cafe in Iceland. The individuals harassed the establishment's employees and forcibly removed a framed map of Palestine displayed on the wall. The incident was documented by the cafe's surveillance cameras.
amharic: በአይስላንድ በሚገኝ የፍልስጤማውያን ባለቤትነት ስር ባለው ካፌ ውስጥ እስራኤላውያን ተብለው የተጠረጠሩ ግለሰቦች ሁከት ፈጥረዋል። ግለሰቦቹ በካፌው ሰራተኞች ላይ የቃላት ጥቃት ከመሰንዘራቸውም በላይ ግድግዳ ላይ የተሰቀለውን የፍልስጤም ካርታ ቀደዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በካፌው የደህንነት ካሜራዎች ተቀርጿል።
oromo: Itoophiyaa keessatti namoonni Israa'elota jedhamanii shakkaman kafee warra Falasxiin qabani tokko keessatti jeequmsa uumaniiru. Namoonni kun hojjattoota kafee sanaa irratti miidhaa erga geessisanii booda, kaartaa Falasxiin kan keessa turee fi dallaa irratti maxxanfame cicciranii kukkutaniiru. Gochi kunis kaameeraa nageenyaa kafee sanatiin waraabamee jira.

title: Erdogan says Hamas acted sincerely, criticises Israeli attacks
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has publicly expressed support for Hamas, describing their recent actions as sincere. During an interview, he strongly condemned Israel's ongoing military operations in Gaza and Lebanon as aggressive. Furthermore, Erdogan noted that Donald Trump is worried about the regional instability, and he emphasized that Turkey remains committed to preventing the conflict from spreading further.
amharic: የቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ታይፕ ኤርዶغان ሀማስ በቅርቡ የወሰዳቸውን እርምጃዎች ቅንነት የተሞላባቸው ናቸው በማለት ድጋፋቸውን ገልጸዋል። በቃለ መጠይቁ ወቅት እስራኤል በጋዛ እና በሊባኖስ እየፈጸመች ያለችውን ወታደራዊ ጥቃት አውግዘዋል። በተጨማሪም ኤርዶغان ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በክልሉ ስላለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ ስጋት እንዳላቸው በመጥቀስ፣ ቱርክ ግጭቱ እንዳይባባስ ጥረቷን እንደምትቀጥል አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Turkii Rajab Tayyib Erdogaan gocha gareen Hamaas raawwate dhugaa fi qulqulluudha jedhanii deggeran. Gargaarsii gaaffii fi deebii isaa irratti, weerara Israa'el Gazaas ta'e Libaanoos irratti gaggeessaa jirtu cimsanii balaaleffatan. Kana malees, Erdogaan Donald Traamp sodaa nageenya naannichaa irratti qaban eeranii, Turkii giddigiddiin kun caalaatti akka hin babal'anne ittisuuf carraaqqii gochuushee itti fuftu ibsan.

title: Trump hails Saudi-Turkiye-Pakistan defence pact
english: Former President Donald Trump publicly praised a new military cooperation agreement signed between Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan. He stated that this 'Mecca Joint Defence Agreement' represents a significant step toward regional stability and self-reliance. Trump congratulated the leaders of these three nations for forming a strategic alliance that he believes will reshape security efforts in the Middle East.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ በቱርክ እና በፓኪስታን መካከል የተፈረመውን የመከላከያ ስምምነት አድንቀዋል። ትራምፕ ይህ የ'መካ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት' ለቀጠናው ደህንነት እና ሀገራቱ ራሳቸውን ለመከላከል የሚያስችላቸው ትልቅ እርምጃ ነው ብለዋል። የሶስቱን ሀገራት መሪዎች ይህንን ስልታዊ ጥምረት በመመስረታቸው አመስግነዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantii duraanii Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp biyyoota Sa'ud Arabiyaa, Turkii fi Paakistaan gidduutti waliigalteen ittisa biyyaa mallattaa'uu isaa gammachuudhaan ibsaniiru. Waliigalteen 'Makaa Joint Defence Agreement' jedhamu kun tasgabbii naannichaa mirkaneessuufi biyyoonni kunneen of ittisuuf gahee guddaa akka qaban ibsameera. Tiraamp hoogganoonni biyyoota sadanii kun tarkaanfii cimaa fi barbaachisaa ta'e kana fudhachuu isaaniif galata galchaniiru.

title: Iran parliament speaker says US used more firepower in Iran than on Vietnam
english: The Speaker of the Iranian Parliament, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, claimed that the United States has deployed more military force against Iran than it did during the Vietnam War. He emphasized that Iran needs to strengthen its defensive capabilities to establish deterrence. According to Ghalibaf, this approach is necessary to prevent the country from being caught in a repetitive pattern of conflict and unstable peace.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈ-ጉባኤ መሀመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ፣ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የተጠቀመችው ወታደራዊ ኃይል ከቬትናም ጦርነት የበለጠ እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። ኢራን ከጦርነት እና ከሰላም ዑደት ለመውጣት የሚያስችል ጠንካራ የመከላከያ አቅም መገንባት እንዳለባትም አሳስበዋል። ይህ የጦር መከላከል አቅም ለአገሪቱ ዘላቂ ሰላም ወሳኝ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iran, Mohammad Baager Gaalibaaf, Amerikaan Iran irratti humna waraanaa addunyaa kan Vietnam irra caalu fayyadamteetti jechuun dubbatan. Iran walitti bu'iinsa fi nagaa gidduutti akka hin hafneef, dandeettii of irraa ittisuu cimaa qabaachuu akka qabdu hubachiisaniiru. Gaalibaaf akka jedhanitti, tatarree humna waraanaa kanaa cimsachuun nageenya biyyattii itti fufsiisuuf murteessadha.

title: US admiral praises USS Lincoln crew amid reported mental health concerns
english: US Admiral Brad Cooper visited the USS Abraham Lincoln to commend its crew, despite growing concerns from lawmakers regarding the sailors' mental health during an unusually long deployment. Reports indicated that crew members were struggling with the psychological toll of being at sea for over 250 days without a break, leading to extreme incidents like attempted jumps overboard. While the Admiral acknowledged that long-term naval service is difficult, he insisted that the ship’s mental health statistics are currently among the best in the fleet as preparations are made to replace the vessel.

oromo: Admiralin US Brad Cooper hoggansa isaa jalatti kan jiru doonii xiyyaaraa USS Abraham Lincoln erga namoonni 250 ol qilleensa baharaa keessa turanii booda dhiphina sammuu irra ga'e hordofuun daawwateera. Miseensonni mana maree biyyattii haala fayyaa sammuu fi yaaliin miseensonni doonichaa of darbuuf godhan isaan yaaddessuu ibsaniiru. Admiralichi hojjettoota doonichaa kan galateeffate yoo ta'u, tajaajilli baharaa keessatti yeroo dheeraa dabarsuu haalaan ulfaataa ta'uu isaa amaneera. Doonii kana kan bakka bu'u dooniin biraa erga qophaa'ee booda, pirezidaantiin biyyattii garuu yeroon doonichaa gahaa akka hin taane ibsaniiru.

title: Brazil: Lula, Bolsonaro return to strongholds to launch runs for president
english: Brazil's presidential candidates, President Lula da Silva and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, have officially launched their campaigns in their respective political heartlands. The election race features significant focus on economic nationalism and securing support from women, who make up the majority of the electorate, through promises to address rising gender-based violence. While Lula focuses on protecting national resources, the Bolsonaro camp is highlighting its ability to foster international trade relationships.

oromo: Hirmaattotni filannoo prezidaantummaa biyya Brazil, prezidaant Lula da Silva fi senatar Flavio Bolsonaro, bakka bu'ummaa isaanii jabaa ta'e irraa duula filannoo isaanii jalqabanii jiru. Duulli filannoo kun qabeenya biyyattii qabaachuu fi sagalee dubartoota biyyattii irratti xiyyeeffata, akkasumas roorroo dubartoota irratti raawwatamu dhaabsisuuf waadaa galaniiru. Lula qabeenya biyyattii eeguu irratti kan xiyyeeffatu yoo ta'u, gama biraatiin gareen Bolsonaro hariiroo daldala biyyoota alaa wajjin jiru cimsuun fedhii isaanii ta'uu ibsanii jiru.

title: US-Iran MoU is set to expire: What to know
english: A peace agreement between the United States and Iran is nearing its expiration date with no clear signs of a renewal. While the deal was intended to stop military conflict and economic disruptions in the Gulf, both nations have accused each other of violating its terms. As the deadline approaches, Iran is exploring alternative maritime arrangements, while the U.S. has signaled a more aggressive stance toward controlling key regional waterways.

Yeroon waliigaltee kun gahuu isaa hordofee, Iran karaa galaana biraa barbaadaa jirti; gama biraatiin ammoo Ameerikaan karaa bishaanii naannichaa to’achuuf tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu akka feetu ibsiteetti.

title: Senegal’s Saint-Louis Regatta keeps centuries of tradition alive
english: Thousands of people recently gathered in Saint-Louis, Senegal, to participate in an annual traditional canoe race. This long-standing event serves as a celebration of the city's deep-rooted history and connection to the fishing industry. The regatta continues to be a vital cultural fixture that preserves local customs for future generations.

title: Trump envoy Kushner meets Hamas leader to push Gaza peace plan
english: US envoy Jared Kushner recently met with Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya in Egypt to discuss a peace proposal aimed at ending the conflict in Gaza. The US-backed plan calls for the disarmament of Hamas, the withdrawal of Israeli military forces, and a reconstruction effort under a new Palestinian civilian authority. While Israel has publicly rejected these terms until complete disarmament occurs, international mediators including Egypt, Qatar, and Turkey are continuing to push for the plan's implementation.

Karoorri Ameerikaan deggeramu kun hidhannoo Haamaas hiiksisuu, waraanni Israa'el Gaazaa gadi lakkisee akka ba'uu fi bulchiinsa siivilii haaraa dhaabuu kan of keessatti qabate dha. Israa'el hidhannoon Haamaas guutummaatti hinhikamin karooricha akka hin fudhanne ibsituus, biyyoonni giddu-galaan akka Gibxii, Qaatar fi Turkii mariin kun akka milkaa'uuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Erdogan says Israeli attacks on Lebanon are a serious concern for Türkiye
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has expressed significant apprehension regarding the ongoing military strikes by Israel against Lebanon. In a recent interview, he highlighted that these hostilities are a major cause of worry for the Turkish government. Erdogan's comments underscore Ankara's growing alarm over the potential for regional instability due to the escalating conflict.

oromo: Pireezidantiin biyya Turkii Rejeb Tayyib Erdogan, haleellaan Israa'el biyya Libaanoos irratti gaggeessaa jirtu biyyattii irratti yaaddoo guddaa akka uume ibsaniiru. title: Iran and Oman work on temporary Hormuz shipping route as Trump threatens to claim the strait
english: Iran and Oman are currently negotiating to create a temporary shipping lane through the Strait of Hormuz because the old paths are no longer usable. Iranian officials clarified that these discussions are focused on navigation logistics and are distinct from broader concerns regarding the potential closure or reopening of the waterway. They hope to finalize this interim arrangement soon before potentially establishing a permanent route in the future.
